craft_notes: Color: lover-miniature (argmap). Firing: marked keeps purpose (samavekSya = observed-to-act); kiss kept blunt (cumbati). No edit. REJECTED OPTIONS (with killers): (a) season->springtime -> killed: season is observed, spring merely comes. (b) vine for creeper -> killed: latA trails. Read aloud: HAV-ing-MARKED hon-ey's-SEA-son — … THE-bee KISS-es THE-yū-thi-kā CREEP-er. Abhinavagupta frame: grove as vibhāva, not backdrop — beauty as cause; kuṭaja-mockery and nīpa-release as anubhāva (consequents), not ornament; rasa overwhelming perception (dust obscuring sun/moon).

lines: the bee kisses the yūthikā creeper.
l4.sanskrit_cite: madhunaḥ samavekṣya kālatāṃ bhramaraś cumbati yūthikālatām

c1_essence: Beauty is not decoration but cause: the groves shine for Kāma's sake, not the reverse. The grove is the vibhāva (determinant) of śṛṅgāra; the rasa overwhelms perception — dust of passion obscures sun and moon, new-cloud-drunk peacocks cry. The kuṭaja's mockery and the nīpa's release are consequents (anubhāva), not ornament: the poet sides with the humble tree over showy flowers. The bee kisses the yūthikā creeper. The rasa is aesthetic: the rasa IS the point.
